theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_ret_nc_map_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (E : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid d → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → v₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Q V → (∀ k ∈ E, Q v₀ k = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z : Euclid d × E => ψ z.1 + (z.2 : Euclid P) - Q z.1 (z.2 : Euclid P)) (V ×ˢ univ) ∧ HasFDerivAt (fun z : Euclid d × E => ψ z.1 + (z.2 : Euclid P) - Q z.1 (z.2 : Euclid P)) ((fderiv ℝ ψ v₀).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Euclid d) E) + E.subtypeL.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Euclid d) E)) (v₀, 0)
